address: Hôtel de l'Abbaye, 20 rue de l'Abbaye-d'Ainay, Lyon, 69002, France
bio: Tucked away in a presbytery converted into a charming hotel, this delightful cosy restaurant serves delicious contemporary cuisine that is aligned with the seasons: cep cream and Ardèche chestnut chunks; meunière-style sturgeon fillet, matelote sauce. The chef's modern cuisine is simple and well executed....
